the baryon mass spectrum is organized into a hierarchy of states of increasing complexity, each of which features a series of degenerate states of steadily increasing spin.

the observed degeneracies are a reflection of the underlying internal structure and dynamics of baryons and that the quark - diquark picture is a viable and attractive model for the description of the baryon mass spectrum.
